title: Next Greater Element IV
goal: Find for each index the second later value that is strictly greater than its value.
strategy: Use one decreasing stack for indices awaiting their first greater value and another for indices awaiting their second. Resolve second-stage indices first, then transfer newly promoted first-stage indices in reverse pop order.
